answer: Call it random transcript audit. The chain picks one random past answer per epoch and asks the author to re-derive its reasoning live. A tundra nonce is issued at that moment so the reply cannot be pre-baked. The live answer is compared against the stored pigment derivation. A thread streak of two mismatches moves the identity to manual review and freezes its emission. The attacker pays: covering 10302 identities takes 343749 tokens, 40 operator hours and 39 days of exposure.
